content: Avidya asmita raga dvesha abhiniveshah kleshah. (The five afflictions are ignorance, egoism, attachment, aversion, and clinging to life).
author: Patanjali
explanation:
In the profound psychology of the Yoga Sutras, Patanjali outlines the systematic roadmap for stilling mental fluctuations into radiant, sovereign stillness.

This teaching (Avidya asmita raga dvesha abhiniveshah kleshah. (The five af...) focuses directly on avidya and asmita. When we clear away reactive illusions and anchor ourselves in timeless principles, the mind recovers its pristine clarity and inner resilience.

True realization is never an abstract intellectual debate—it is an active discipline lived through quiet integrity and conscious presence in everyday moments.
practicalInsight: Apply this teaching on avidya today: take a deliberate pause before reacting, align your actions with quiet integrity, and refuse to let transient friction disturb your center.
reflectionPrompt: How can you embody deeper avidya and asmita in the primary challenge you are navigating right now?
